_doc: Stills models for remote_stills_*.py, chosen by shots_to_jobs.py --model. Owner's rule (2026-11-25): step-distilled 'turbo' models are for drafts and layout only, never for anything that ships; their stills are stamped draft and render refuses them. 'default' is the model shots_to_jobs.py uses without --model. Every model here has commercially usable weights, with the licence read from its model card on the date given. full_gpu_gb, when set, is the card memory at which the whole pipeline goes on the GPU; below it the model loads one component at a time (default 1.5 x min_vram_gb). Excluded for licence: black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-dev (non-commercial).
default_note: Provisional until the 2026-11-25 A100 bake-off (Qwen-Image 2512 against full Z-Image) picks the winner.
